entries.body:
CURRENT [S1.1] Format: CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; rows ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.2] Scope: admin exports any project; other roles only records whose project in user[projects]; others silently omitted.
CURRENT [S1.3] Confidential records never exported, except when role admin and params purpose==audit; other rules still apply.
CURRENT [S2.1] Only status active exported, unless params include_archived is True, then archived too.
CURRENT [S2.2] Obligation: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format must include top-level field exported_by = user[name]; stays unless withdrawn/changed.
CURRENT [S2.3] Title exported with leading/trailing whitespace stripped.
HISTORY [S1.4] Decision record: CSV chosen for first release because finance imports into spreadsheets.
Stage1-2 done: exporter/core.py implements S1.1-1.3,S2.1,S2.3; reghelper.py has affected(reg,new) via jev and set_register(c,lines).
